name: playtest-recorder-monorepo
description: Playtest session recorder: record any screen target via OBS, hotkey-mark moments, dictate notes, and generate a condensed report (self-hosted page + Notion) that plays only the marked segments.
author: George <georgetw1108@gmail.com>

scripts.build: npm run build -w @playtest/shared && npm run build -w @playtest/notion-publisher && npm run build -w playtest-recorder
